latest_release.name: v3.27.3
latest_release.body: - **dsh: GLM vision models keep their native sight behind gateways that spell versions with dashes ([#126](https://github.com/liustack/modlens/issues/126)).** The name check that keeps native vision models out of the `(modlens vision)` wrap only knew the dotted spelling (`glm-5.3-flash`, `glm-4.6v`). Gateways such as Raccoon serve the same models as `sn-glm-5-3-flash` and `sn-glm-4-6v`, so after adding the gateway prefix to `families`, a catalog that omits modalities would have handed a vision model a wrapper twin. Both spellings are now excluded, and the text-only `sn-glm-5-3` still wraps. Default family matching stays prefix-only: a gateway namespace is opted in through `families`, as before.
